newsitem.title: USA: Alltrista sees lower Q1 on coinage shipment drop.
newsitem.headline: Alltrista sees lower Q1 on coinage shipment drop.

text.p: Alltrista Corp said Monday that it expects a drop in domestic coinage shipments to result in lower earnings for the first quarter.

"We'll have lower domestic coinage shipments during the first quarter, as the Federal Reserve System adjusts inventories," Thomas Clark, president, said in a statement. "This will result in the company reporting somewhat lower earnings in the first quarter; however, for the year we expect comparisons to be quite favorable."
For the first quarter of 1996, Alltrista earned $0.42 a share, or $0.41 a share fully diluted, on sales of $69.1 million.
Earlier, Alltrista reported earnings for the fourth quarter of $0.18 a share compared with a loss of $0.03 a year ago. For the full year, it earned $1.83 a share compared with $1.44.
Earnings from continuing operations were $0.27 a share for the fourth quarter, up from $0.25 a year ago, and $1.92 for all of 1996, up from $1.56.

"With the exception of our consumer products business, all operations had either comparable or higher operating earnings for the year," Clark said. "A poor growing season and costs incurred to integrate an acquisition were responsible for lower earnings from that business."

The company said its food containers segment had a five percent increase in sales and an 11 percent increase in operating earnings for the year. Consumer products accounted for the increased sales, while the rise in operating earnings resulted from improved efficiencies in plastic packaging.

"We're expecting increased operating earnings in consumer products in 1997," Clark said, adding benefits are expected from the consolidation of production facilities and better pricing for key raw materials used.
Sales in the industrial components segment were three percent above a year ago, and operating earnings were 16 percent higher than 1995.

Within the segment, zinc products had increased volume in its coinage product line, but lower volume and earnings from the industrial and battery can product lines. The industrial plastics business had improved operating earnings, while the injection molding operation's earnings were off slightly.
